# outputs/drivers/heat_flux/ — Regional Heat-Flux Series

Daily-aligned regional latent (SLHF) and sensible (SSHF) heat-flux timeseries and overview figures.

## Contents

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `csv/{region}_slhf.csv`, `{region}_sshf.csv` | Regional flux series |
| `figures/` | Timeseries plots per region/variable |

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/extract_heat_flux.py` (and summary helpers such as `heat_flux_summary.py`).

## Upstream / Downstream

| Upstream | Downstream |
|----------|------------|
| `data/raw/heat_flux_data_2006_2025/` | `heat_flux_analysis/`, master catalogue, `src/ml` flux features |

## Notes

Source fields are ~weekly; scripts forward-fill to daily where analyses require daily alignment.
